rows.notes: Blockage-capable. Provenance resolved: WallAssets-registered, not stock. WallAssets/Config/WallAssets.Package.json registers prop 'Brickwall' -> /Game/WallAssets/Static/Wall/Brickwall/brick_brickwall; stock Carla/Config/Default.Package.json has no brick/wall prop (verified f2d commit 72fea27). Measured via the blueprint route (blueprint_extents.json); the pack's mesh files are non-SM_ so the SM_-only mesh inventory does not list them (WallAssets = 0 mesh rows). Sibling static.prop.autobahn/asset_highway_barrier is WallAssets-registered the same way.
